name: scene3d_generate_actor_motion
description: Whole-replace one person performance in one Motion take from ordered prompt cues and optional absolute x/z waypoints. This controls only the person rig and root path; it cannot move or attach scene props, so describe an approach, reach, lean or reaction instead of pickup/open/hold/contact claims. Requires the latest etag from scene3d_get_actor_motion. The server owns ids, metric travel timing, arrivals, actor rest pose, durable pending state, idempotency and conflict-safe commit. @see guides_get('scene3d')

animations.description: Ordered multi-prompt cues that whole-replace this actor performance and must total exactly the take duration (max 30s), so the person is animated for every frame. Prefer explicit durationSeconds on timed routed cues; the server validates their implied physical speed. Put every routed cue first and at most one unconstrained/unrouted cue last.

durationSeconds.description: 2–10 seconds in 0.5s steps. Required without waypoints. With waypoints, use this when choreography must occupy an exact interval: the server derives and validates the physical speed. Do not combine with travelSpeedMps.

prompt.description: English physical behavior, self-contained, ideally beginning “A person…”. Controls only the person, never a scene prop: do not claim pickup, opening, holding, attachment, precise contact, gaze or synchronization. Use approach, reach, lean, notice and reaction. Do not describe route coordinates here.

smoothing.description: Path corner smoothing from 0 (straight segments) to 1 (widest rounding).

travelSpeedMps.description: Routed cue alternative to durationSeconds. Desired physical m/s before provider 0.5s duration quantization; default natural walk 1.35. Typical: slow walk 0.9, brisk 1.7, jog 2.5, run 4.0.

waypoints.description: Optional absolute world x/z route points, in order (1u=2.1875m). Server assigns ids/arrivals. For exact choreography, pass durationSeconds and let the server validate implied speed; otherwise duration derives from distance + travelSpeedMps. Routed cues must precede an unrouted cue because its generated endpoint is unknown in advance.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this generation. Reuse the same key only to retry the same call; a new generation needs a new key.
